agentId.description: Platform-minted agent id, created on first save.

displayName.description: Display name shown in the designer and in channels.

schemaName.description: Platform-generated Dataverse schema name. Read-only after first save.

environmentId.description: Power Platform environment id, `Default-<tenantGuid>` for default envs.

description.description: Description surfaced in the agent list and in channel metadata.

AgentIdentity.description:
The immutable half of an agent.

The agent id is minted by the platform on the first successful save, not at the moment the create dialog is submitted. Publish, Share, and Evaluate stay disabled until that first save completes, because each of them needs the id.

`schemaName` is generated by the platform with a random suffix and is read-only from the moment it is assigned. It is the Dataverse logical name used in `bots(...)` lookups.

Guid.description: A GUID in canonical 8-4-4-4-12 lowercase form.
